programs.title: Secrets of the Octopus
programs.desc: We discover eight different species of octopuses in the depths of the sea.Each has a unique personality and great intelligence.Despite drastic differences, these animals turn out to be surprisingly similar to humans.

programs.title: Incredible Dr. Pol 10
programs.desc: Another season of hard work by Dr. Jan Pol and his colleagues.The team will need a new member because Dr. Emily is expecting a baby and someone will have to replace her.

programs.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol 8
programs.desc: Doctor Pol and his team help animals in need.The veterinary clinic staff will face many challenges, such as creating a hoof prosthesis or helping stressed cows.

programs.title: Critter Fixers: Country Vets 4
programs.desc: South of Atlanta, Drs. Hodges and Ferguson run the Critter Fixer Veterinary Clinic.Together with their staff, they treat over 20,000 people.patients per year.They often receive unique cases.

programs.title: Dead By Dawn
programs.desc: Nat Geo Wild explores the beauty and ferocity of the animal kingdom, offering an intimate look at the world’s most incredible creatures in their habitats.

programs.title: One Strange Rock
programs.desc: A story about the creation and history of the planet, the laws governing it, its shape, the richness of flora and fauna, threats to the natural environment, natural wonders and surprising relationships.Actor Will Smith and people who have had the opportunity to spend time in space will talk about this extraordinary place in the universe.Accounts from astronauts including Mae Jemison, Mike Massimino, Leland Melvin and Chris Austin Hadfield will provide a completely new perspective on Earth.Director Darren Aronofsky and his film crew visited 45 countries and six continents.The photos were taken in, among others, the Arctic, the Himalayas, India and during the annual festival in Tarragona, Spain.Materials recorded on board the International Space Station were also used.In the following episodes, viewers will learn how oxygen is produced, the protective layers of the Blue Planet and the entire sequence of events that led to the creation of life.The topic of death, colonization, destruction, the search for alien forms and human intellect will also be discussed.

programs.title: Thailand's Wild Cats
programs.desc: The ancient kingdom is hidden deep in the jungle and is the last refuge for wild cats in Thailand.Its inhabitants include three females: a clouded leopard, a female tarai and a tigress.

programs.title: Animal fights
programs.desc: Unique shots of spectacular clashes involving the largest and most dangerous predators on our planet.This extraordinary series also features animals that, although seemingly gentle, are surprisingly belligerent when threatened.We will see how brave they are, among others.lions, wolves, hippos and crocodiles.We will see how much the result of the duel depends on strength and weapons such as teeth or claws, and how much on good tactics.The program used materials recorded by the best nature photographers, as well as films made by amateurs who witnessed fierce fights in the animal world.

programs.title: United States of Animals: Compilation Season 1
programs.desc: Viewers will meet extraordinary inhabitants of the USA and gain practical tips on how and when to see them with their own eyes.

programs.title: Animal Genius
programs.desc: Biologist Liz Bonnin has been revealing the secrets of the fauna kingdom for years.In this film, he observes animals that are very good at fighting predators, even though they do not have sharp claws and fangs.Their survival is related to skills such as communication and cooperation.It turns out that nature still hides many secrets from us.The observed animals surprise scientists who make new discoveries.This time they will learn patents for survival, including:in Africa and Mexico.There is strength in a herd. Charming meerkats have already been the heroines of many documentaries and TV series.Curious mammals living in the Kalahari Desert are exposed to attacks by predators.They can inform each other about various threats.Their characteristic sound signals are crucial.Viewers will also watch the battle between Matabele warrior ants and termites.Unusual insects can provide first aid to injured companions.In Mexico, Liz Bonnin will observe sea turtles.The small reptiles face a dangerous journey to the ocean.They move towards the water together, increasing their chances of survival.These scenes show that in nature, it is not only the strongest who survive, but also the best connected.

programs.title: Australia's Land of the Ancients
programs.desc: Northeast Australia is the most biodiverse region on the continent.Viewers will learn about the saltwater crocodile and the habits of cassowaries.They will also witness the pageboy's metamorphosis.
